nodes.name: project.yml
nodes.summary: Serena MCP project configuration defining language servers, workspace folders, ignored paths, tool exclusions, and default operating modes for the deep-harn repository.

nodes.name: .understandignore
nodes.summary: Template ignore-pattern file for the Understand-Anything analysis tool, listing commented-out glob patterns (from .gitignore conventions and common test-file naming) that can be uncommented to exclude paths from codebase analysis.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Empty Python package marker file that makes backend/app importable as a package.

nodes.name: agentic.py
nodes.summary: LangGraph agent pipeline that turns a lecture transcript and extracted video frames into a structured multi-module course — orchestrating Gemini/Groq LLM calls (with tenacity retry and OpenTelemetry tracing) across content structuring, frame selection, course content generation, quiz creation, and spaced-retention plan design.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses tenacity @retry decorators wrapping Gemini/Groq chain invocations, each also wrapped in an OpenTelemetry span, giving per-LLM-call retry and observability across every LangGraph node function.

nodes.name: utils.py
nodes.summary: Small utility module providing LLM-output JSON cleanup (stripping markdown code fences) and base64 image encoding helpers used by the agentic course-generation pipeline.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Empty Python package marker file for the backend/app/db package.

nodes.name: broadcaster.py
nodes.summary: In-memory Server-Sent Events broadcaster (MessageAnnouncer) that manages per-job async queues for progress subscribers, publishes JSON-formatted progress events, and tracks job status for the course-generation SSE stream.

nodes.name: requirements.txt
nodes.summary: Python dependency manifest for the backend service, pinning FastAPI/uvicorn, LangChain/LangGraph with Gemini and Groq integrations, video/audio processing libraries (yt-dlp, opencv, whisper, scenedetect, fiftyone), OpenTelemetry instrumentation, and PostgreSQL/S3 clients, with inline notes explaining resolved version conflicts.

nodes.name: start.sh
nodes.summary: Container entrypoint script that runs a preflight import check of the heavy dependency stack (fiftyone, the LangGraph agent, the FastAPI app) before launching uvicorn as a single worker on port 8000, since in-memory progress queues require a single process.
nodes.languageNotes: Deliberately pinned to a single uvicorn worker/process because SSE progress state (PROGRESS_QUEUES / ACTIVE_TASKS in app/api/routes.py) lives in process memory rather than a shared store.

nodes.name: nginx.conf
nodes.summary: Nginx server configuration serving the built React SPA — enables gzip compression, sets long-lived immutable caching for hashed static assets, and falls back all unmatched routes to index.html for client-side routing.

nodes.name: App.css
nodes.summary: Default Create React App stylesheet for the root App component, providing the boilerplate centered layout, spinning logo animation, and header styling from the CRA template.

nodes.name: index.css
nodes.summary: Global base stylesheet setting the default system font stack and monospace code font for the whole React application.

nodes.name: react-app-env.d.ts
nodes.summary: Create React App TypeScript ambient type declaration reference file enabling CRA's built-in type definitions (e.g. for static asset imports).

nodes.name: setupTests.ts
nodes.summary: Jest test setup file that imports jest-dom's custom DOM matchers (e.g. toHaveTextContent) for use across the frontend test suite.

nodes.name: tsconfig.tsbuildinfo
nodes.summary: Auto-generated TypeScript incremental build cache file tracking compiled file state for faster rebuilds; not hand-maintained source.

nodes.name: log_retry_error
nodes.summary: Tenacity retry-callback that logs a warning and records an OpenTelemetry span event whenever an LLM call is retried after failure.

nodes.name: call_gemini_with_retry
nodes.summary: Invokes a LangChain chain against Gemini with tenacity-managed retries, wrapping the call in an OpenTelemetry span that records input/output sizes, latency, and error status.

nodes.name: call_groq_with_retry
nodes.summary: Invokes a LangChain chain against Groq with tenacity-managed retries, tracing the call span with attributes for latency and payload sizes analogous to the Gemini variant.

nodes.name: content_structurer
nodes.summary: LangGraph node that prompts Gemini to convert a raw transcript into a structured JSON outline of course modules and sections, parsing and cleaning the LLM's JSON response.

nodes.name: frame_selector
nodes.summary: LangGraph node that iterates each structured section, matches candidate video frames by timestamp, base64-encodes them, and asks Groq's vision model to pick the most representative frame with a caption for each section.

nodes.name: course_content_generator
nodes.summary: LangGraph node that expands the structured outline into full course content (explanations, examples) per section via a Gemini chat prompt, parsing the returned JSON.

nodes.name: quiz_architect
nodes.summary: LangGraph node that generates quiz questions for each course section using Gemini, validating and logging the total question count produced.

nodes.name: retention_designer
nodes.summary: LangGraph node that designs a spaced-retention study plan (review schedule and tip placeholders) for the generated course content via a Gemini prompt.

nodes.name: retention_tip_executor
nodes.summary: LangGraph node that fills in retention plan placeholders with concrete study tips, selecting from multiple prompt templates per tip type and calling Gemini to generate each tip's content.

nodes.name: GraphState
nodes.summary: TypedDict defining the shared LangGraph state schema (transcript, frames, structured_content, course_content, quiz_content, retention_plan) threaded through every pipeline node.

nodes.name: clean_json_string
nodes.summary: Strips markdown code fences and extraneous text from an LLM's raw text response to extract a parseable JSON string, with fallback heuristics and validation via json.loads.

nodes.name: encode_image
nodes.summary: Reads an image file from disk and returns its base64-encoded string, used to embed frames in vision-LLM prompts.

nodes.name: MessageAnnouncer
nodes.summary: Thread-safe, in-memory pub/sub manager that tracks per-job asyncio queues of SSE subscribers, publishes JSON progress events to all listeners for a job, and stores/retrieves per-job status for late subscribers.

nodes.name: format_sse
nodes.summary: Formats a Python dict as a properly-encoded Server-Sent Events data frame (JSON-serialized, newline-terminated).
